name: native-powerpoint-doc-editor
description: Open, search, and edit DOCX and PPTX files directly in your vault.

scripts.build: npm run i18n:generate && npm run ai:generate && npm run check:ai-capabilities && npm run i18n:validate && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/check-no-dynamic-script.mjs && node scripts/check-mobile-compat.mjs && node scripts/check-pptx-js-engine-version.mjs && node scripts/check-theme-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-theme-css.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-ui-patterns.mjs
scripts.check:dead-pptx-controllers: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'; const view = readFileSync('src/powerpoint/ui/NativePowerPointView.ts', 'utf8'); const controllers = [['arrangeController', 'ArrangeController'], ['insertController', 'InsertController'], ['inspectorController', 'InspectorController'], ['selectionDragController', 'SelectionDragController'], ['textToolbarController', 'TextToolbarController']]; const unused = controllers.filter(([file, symbol]) => !existsSync('src/powerpoint/' + file + '.ts') || !view.includes(\"../\" + file + \"'\") || !new RegExp('new\\\\s+' + symbol + '\\\\b').test(view)); if (unused.length) { throw new Error('Unused PPTX controllers: ' + unused.map(([file]) => file).join(', ')); }"
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run smoke:pptx-js && npm run smoke:mobile-pptx && npm run smoke:pptx-action-matrix && npm run check:pptx-action-logs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

codeAnalysis.pluginBundleBudgetReason: Single-file offline DOCX and PPTX editing bundles the vendored document editors, PowerPoint renderer, and JavaScript fallback engine.
